eligibility_rules: Family name or table label is not an identity component by itself; matching full scientific identity may make Table5/7 or common baseline outputs aliases.
Different training labels/support/normalizer, architecture, loss, ASF/FT policy, source-version, seed or validation rule prevents state reuse.

Different query support may reuse a sealed training state, but requires distinct inference/collection receipts; the training identity does not include a query merely to force a refit, except for explicitly transductive training that actually consumes it.
Candidate A/B learned states are independently produced; common trusted references are operator-owned and never exposed as candidate answers.

Frozen features may be shared only with identical upstream state and deterministic input transforms; trainable ASF before nonlinear encoder usually prevents reuse across heads or fitted ASF states. FullFT never uses a stale LP feature cache.

Parameter sharing inside a participant's actual multioutput learner is allowed when its scientific method/policy supports it and alloutputs are genuinely computed; evaluator cannot replace required distinct historical methods with one shared shortcut.
Independent fitting is the fallback when equality, numerical conditioning or native parity is not established. No empirical speedup is asserted.

No cross-fold label-dependent code/config/state/cache reuse, even with equal bytes. G0/corpus-only independent resources require exact eligibility for every descendant. Trusted A/B alias preserves local fold/control/repetition selection ancestry.

No budget transfer or shared adaptive search across folds. A frozen scheduler can parallelize independently eligible E jobs; after performance exposure it cannot change procedures or give later folds extra search.
